limitations.L1: endovascularly implantable CSF shunt device having a shunt body with opposed first and second ends, the first end configured for deployment in a subarachnoid space and the second end configured for deployment in a dural venous sinus
limitations.L2: a first pressure sensor disposed at or near the first end, configured to continuously measure cerebrospinal fluid pressure
limitations.L3: a second pressure sensor disposed at or near the second end, configured to continuously measure venous pressure
limitations.L4: a differential pressure calculator configured to compute a CSF-venous pressure differential from the first and second pressure measurements
limitations.L5: an occlusion prediction module configured to predict shunt occlusion from a temporal trend of the CSF-venous pressure differential, without requiring exogenous contrast agent injection
limitations.L6: wherein the occlusion prediction is based on a rate of change of the pressure differential exceeding a predetermined threshold
limitations.L7: integrated into the eShunt anatomy (dural venous sinus deployment)

claim_language_verbatim: An endovascularly implantable CSF shunt monitoring system comprising: a shunt body having opposed first and second ends, the first end configured for deployment in a subarachnoid space and the second end configured for deployment in a dural venous sinus; a first pressure sensor disposed at or near the first end, configured to continuously measure cerebrospinal fluid pressure; a second pressure sensor disposed at or near the second end, configured to continuously measure venous pressure; a differential pressure calculator configured to compute a CSF-venous pressure differential from the first and second pressure measurements; and an occlusion prediction module configured to predict shunt occlusion from a temporal trend of the CSF-venous pressure differential, without requiring exogenous contrast agent injection, wherein the occlusion prediction is based on a rate of change of the pressure differential exceeding a predetermined threshold.
